items.title: 68099_Erskine Hawkins oral history interview
items.q: He was, I didn't know Tiny too well. But, I had a lot of fun with him.

ctx.x: Tiny Bradshaw. He was up the Savoy quite a few times. This was before Chick Webb and Benny Goodman had, they started having those, you know, good Swing sessions up there.
He was, I didn't know Tiny too well. But, I had a lot of fun with him. I think he was a drummer. I'm not sure. But, he directed.
Yeah. I never saw him play anything. He used to have the baton. I never knew what he played.
